name: Email Preview and Approval
description: Presents a draft in the Email Studio with true rendered desktop and mobile previews, lets the user edit every field, regenerate content or change tone, and records an explicit approval bound to a content hash. Nothing can be sent without this approval.

alsoTriggeredBy: user opens a draft in Email Studio

uiRequirements.previewRendering: The preview MUST render the actual HTML email, not the HTML source. Use an <iframe sandbox="" srcdoc="..."> (no scripts, no same-origin) for each preview. Desktop frame width 700 px; mobile frame width 375 px. The plain-text fallback is shown on a separate tab.
editableFields: body content (via regeneration or direct edit of templateData)
uiRequirements.referenceImplementation: scripts/build-email-preview.js produces a static two-frame preview page from any template.

steps.name: Load draft and context
steps.description: Read the EmailDraft, related Opportunity and attachment candidates (OrganisationDocument and Application files).

steps.name: Render desktop and mobile previews
steps.description: Render htmlBody into two sandboxed iframes and textBody into a plain-text tab. Re-render after every edit.

steps.name: User edits
steps.description: User edits subject, recipients (to, cc, bcc), attachments and tone. Each edit re-runs quality checks and invalidates any existing approval.

steps.name: Regenerate content
steps.description: Call WF-05 with the user's instruction and/or new tone, then return to render-previews. Capped at 10 regenerations per draft.

steps.name: Pre-send checklist
steps.description: Show and enforce: recipients valid and within maxRecipientsPerEmail; no recipient on the SuppressionList; subject present; attachments selected and under size limit; links point to verified domains; no unresolved placeholders; DRY_RUN status displayed prominently.

steps.name: Final approval
steps.description: An authorised approver (APPROVER_EMAILS) approves, rejects or sends back. On approval, store approvedBy, approvedAt and contentHash (src/lib/approval.js) and set status "approved". Any later change to subject, recipients, body or attachments voids the approval.

steps.name: Cancel draft
steps.description: Set status to cancelled; log the reason.

aiInstructions.reason: No AI call in this workflow; regeneration is delegated to WF-05 (step regenerate).

integrations.name: Email Studio UI
integrations.base44Mapping: Custom page with sandboxed iframe previews and EmailDraft form

output.description: EmailDraft with status approved (with approval block and contentHash), rejected or cancelled.

onUnrecoverableFailure: Set the run status to "failed" and stop; never continue past a failed safety check.
Write a WorkflowLog entry with level "error" and the failing stepId.
Send an internal alert to INTERNAL_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL (internal only; never to external recipients).
errorHandling.idempotency: Every run carries a runId. Writes use natural keys (fingerprint, draftId, followUpId) so a retried run cannot create duplicates or send twice.

specificCases.action: Set status back to pending_approval and clear the approval record.

approval.rationale: Every external message needs explicit human approval tied to the exact content that will be sent.

logging.redaction: Never log credentials, OAuth tokens or full email bodies. Log IDs and content hashes instead.

base44.automation: Interactive page; backend function approveEmailDraft must verify the caller's identity against APPROVER_EMAILS server-side.
base44.notes: Never trust a client-side flag for approval state.
